name: 恶魔仪式
description: 战斗开始时，基尔加丹隐匿于虚空，并留下【恶魔召唤(1)】。依次打出5张召唤牌后，基尔加丹会被召唤至指定格子。
code: function executeSkill(context) { var kj = context.piece || context.rulePiece; if (!kj) return { success: false, message: '' }; var idx = battle.pieces.findIndex(function(p) { return p.instanceId === kj.instanceId; }); if (idx === -1) return { success: false, message: '' }; battle.pieces.splice(idx, 1); if (!battle.extensions) battle.extensions = {}; var strippedRules = (kj.rules || []).map(function(r) { var rc = {}; for (var k in r) { if (k !== 'effect') rc[k] = r[k]; } return rc; }); var kjCopy = {}; for (var key in kj) { if (key !== 'rules') kjCopy[key] = kj[key]; } kjCopy.rules = strippedRules; try { battle.extensions.kiljaedanPiece = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(kjCopy)); } catch(e) { battle.extensions.kiljaedanPiece = { instanceId: kj.instanceId, templateId: kj.templateId, ownerPlayerId: kj.ownerPlayerId, name: kj.name, faction: kj.faction }; } addCardToHand('demon-summon-1', kj.ownerPlayerId); return { success: true, message: '基尔加丹隐匿于虚空之中，等待召唤...' }; }
